confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors draw on aggregated 2026 cost-of-living figures and Edinburgh guide ranges, not single venues; restaurant ranges are wide. Sterling was converted at an assumed 1.33 USD per GBP, not a live quote. Cocktail reflects a midpoint of 2026 bar-guide ranges (roughly GBP 10-15); wine_glass is set at about 1.2x the beer anchor because restaurant wine-by-the-glass sources were sparse or dated. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season (August Festival premiums excluded), not checked against live listings. FX is the latest RBA figure surfaced by search, not verified on the live F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was used. Food and drink anchors are Edinburgh-specific; accommodation is a holistic estimate for Edinburgh as a high-demand UK city-break destination in peak summer.
